policy_description: Baseline threshold: review score >=70, simulated hold/step-up score >=90.
Lower threshold: review score >=50, designed to improve recall but may increase false positives.
Higher threshold: review score >=85, designed to reduce workload and false positives.
Capacity-aware queue: candidates score >=50 are ranked by risk score; only daily capacity is reviewed.
Cost-sensitive queue: review only when expected review utility is positive, then rank by expected utility.
